summary: Intel Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $6.5 billion aggregate principal amount of Senior Notes across five tranches (2031-2066) in a registered public offering. The notes were sold under an underwriting agreement with Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Barclays, BofA Securities, and Deutsche Bank. Net proceeds are approximately $6.47 billion after underwriting discounts. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing is a shelf takedown, reported under Item 8.01 as a material event, but it does not involve M&A, restructuring, or a capital return.
